fact: On 7 September 2026 the Council of Ministers adopted a bill on banking regulation transposing the June 2023 UMOA uniform law, which brings payment institutions and e-money institutions into the regulated perimeter with reinforced depositor protection; the text names no consumer-conduct rules for digital finance.
title: Réformes Bancaires Adoptées en Conseil des Ministres
publisher: Ministère des Finances et du Budget
